page.running_head: De Agro Frif. intet Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: cohærent: & velle, ut hoc ipsum decretum suum sit constans & irrevocabile etiam apud posteros: mandare vero, ut senatus commissas hasce regiones cum fide tueatur, regat, pacatas servet: adhæc jubere quoque, Ut QUI IN CONSULATU AUT SENATU IAM SUNT, QUIVE POST IN EUM LEGITIME LEGENTUR, IN EQUESTRI ORDINE OMNES CENSEANTUR: pecuniæ quoque aureæ argenteæque feriundæ jus & potestatem senatui eidem facere: Pro his poscere vicissim, ex assignatà hac provinciâ ut X millia aureorum Rhenensium tributum quotannis sibi pendant: In hunc finem Joannem Steinbergium & Arnoldum Loïm jurecunsultos legatos in Frisiam jam mittere, qui cingulo Equestri Consules & senatores pro more induant, ac reliquis ejus ordinis insignibus ornent, ornatosque statim in possessionem potestatis istius in regionibus Transflavicanæ Frisiæ immittant, omnesque earum regionum ordines jubeant, senatui huic velut Imperatoris legato perpetuo, justa ac legitima edicenti, statutaque promulganti parere, nonsecus ac ipse ea ediceret & promulgaret Imperator. Pœnaque contumacibus Nota»

page.notes: The left margin carries a printed "»" mark beside each line of the text; these are typographic marks, not transcribed. The catchword "& huic" stands at the lower right and is taken as the catchword. The small-caps passage "QUI IN CONSULATU ... CENSEANTUR" is set in capitals as printed. "Nota»" is the only marginal note word. Spelling kept as printed (intet, Lavic., assignatà, provinciâ). The printed "Ioannem" is given as "Joannem" under the i/j rule.
